messages.subject: Problems Installing RQuantLib
parts:
I recently opened a Shiny beta hosting account and have been trying to upload a small application I made. The application relies on RQuantLib, which I'm having trouble installing on the server. Attempted installations fail with the error message 'configure: error: Please install QuantLib before trying to build RQuantLib.'

Presumably this means I need to install Boost and QuantLib, which I can't seem to do because I don't have write access to /usr/lib. I'm pretty inexperienced with linux so maybe the solution here is obvious, but can anyone provide some guidance on how I might install these packages?

Thanks,
David
